policy.sourcePriority: Official Supreme Court questionnaire; Lawphil questionnaire archive for 2018–2019.
policy.questionRule: The official question body is immutable. Preserve it word-for-word; omit only visual PDF line wrapping and a standalone item number already rendered by the UI.
policy.answerRule: Change answer-side fields only for an independently identified prompt-answer mismatch, using disclosed suggested-answer cross-checks and controlling Philippine primary authorities. Never change AI model grading logic in this content release.
policy.unresolvedRule: Never invent or split question wording when the official source and the current two-row schema conflict.
